_openIslandOriginalStatusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); name=$(basename "$dir"); branch=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then if ! git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || ! git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then printf "\033[36m➜  %s\033[0m \033[33mgit:(%s) ✗\033[0m" "$name" "$branch"; else printf "\033[36m➜  %s\033[0m \033[32mgit:(%s) ✓\033[0m" "$name" "$branch"; fi; else printf "\033[36m➜  %s\033[0m" "$name"; fi
